Implemented the translation hardening and regenerated the broken Armenian components guide.

What changed:
- Tightened the Markdown translation prompt in [tools/translation-adapters/src/markdown.ts](tools/translation-adapters/src/markdown.ts).
- Added `assertCleanMarkdownTranslation()` to reject model commentary, repeated-character garbage, unexpected CJK characters for non-CJK targets, and duplicated document starts.
- Wired that validator into `AiTranslationAdapter.translateMarkdown()` in [docs/scripts/api-translation.ts](docs/scripts/api-translation.ts).
- Added `DOCS_TRANSLATION_FILE` support via [docs/scripts/translation-scope.ts](docs/scripts/translation-scope.ts), used by [docs/scripts/translate-guide-po.ts](docs/scripts/translate-guide-po.ts), so single-guide forced retries are possible.
- Documented the new scope knob in [docs/conventions/build-and-docs.md](docs/conventions/build-and-docs.md).
- Added tests and changesets.
- Re-ran the scoped Armenian translation for [docs/hy/guide/components.md](docs/hy/guide/components.md) and updated `l10n/hy/docs.guides.po`.

Validation:
- Passed: `vp test docs/scripts/translation-scope.test.ts tools/translation-adapters/tests/markdown.test.ts docs/scripts/api-translation.test.ts`
- Passed with warning: `vp check` has 0 errors, but still reports an unrelated existing `typescript(unbound-method)` warning in [docs/scripts/build-locales.main.test.ts](docs/scripts/build-locales.main.test.ts).
- Passed: `vp test --coverage --exclude tools/i18n-engine/tests/pipeline-home.test.ts --exclude tools/i18n-engine/tests/pipeline-guides.test.ts`
- Blocked: full `vp test --coverage` fails on unrelated locale parity state:
  - all guide PO catalogs currently include one obsolete translated entry, so `pipeline-guides.test.ts` sees 9 translated entries for 8 guide files
  - `pipeline-home.test.ts` reports an Arabic home-page action ordering mismatch
- Blocked: `vp run @pantoken/docs#docs:check:drift` fails on broad existing `docs.api` drift across 43 locales.

The regenerated Armenian guide no longer contains the original agent reasoning output, repeated restarts, `任` garbage, or mixed `Deprecated`/`Attribute` artifacts.
